<section class="lab-intro">

<p class="lab-subtitle">Computer Learning & Advanced Visual Research Lab</p>

<p class="lab-tagline">Perceive. Learn. Advance.</p>

CLAVR (pronunced:klay-vur) sits at the critical turning point of computer vision and unsupervised machine learning. By building generalized, self-supervised models that process complex visual inputs without human intervention, our lab creates a foundational computing umbrella capable of advancing diverse real-world systems from optimizing battery grids and parsing geospatial terrain to automating precision ecosystems.

## Vision

To advance a future where computer vision and machine learning systems can learn robust, meaningful representations from the world with minimal reliance on human-labeled data, enabling scalable, adaptable AI that generalizes across real-world domains from healthcare to agriculture to environmental monitoring.

## Mission

Our lab develops unsupervised and self-supervised learning methods for object detection, image retrieval, and large-scale vision models, working at the intersection of theory and application to ensure our methods solve real problems, while training the next generation of researchers through mentorship and open collaboration.

</section>

<script>
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("clavr-network");
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const page = canvas.parentElement;
  let width, height, nodes;
  const AREA_PER_NODE = 5500;
  const LINK_DIST = 150;

  function resize() {
    width = canvas.width = page.offsetWidth;
    height = canvas.height = page.offsetHeight;
    const count = Math.max(40, Math.round((width * height) / AREA_PER_NODE));
    makeNodes(count);
  }

  function makeNodes(count) {
    nodes = Array.from({ length: count }, () => ({
      x: Math.random() * width,
      y: Math.random() * height,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45,
    }));
  }

  function step() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    for (const n of nodes) {
      n.x += n.vx;
      n.y += n.vy;
      if (n.x < 0 || n.x > width) n.vx *= -1;
      if (n.y < 0 || n.y > height) n.vy *= -1;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < nodes.length; j++) {
        const a = nodes[i], b = nodes[j];
        const dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y;
        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (dist < LINK_DIST) {
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(63, 124, 176, ${0.45 * (1 - dist / LINK_DIST)})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
          ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
    }

    for (const n of nodes) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(44, 74, 102, 0.85)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(n.x, n.y, 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  resize();
  requestAnimationFrame(step);

  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(page);

  const revealTargets = document.querySelectorAll(
    ".clavr-content > .lab-hero, .clavr-content > .lab-intro, .clavr-content > .clavr-section, .clavr-content > .clavr-section .lab-focus-card"
  );
  revealTargets.forEach((el, i) => {
    el.classList.add("clavr-reveal");
    el.style.transitionDelay = `${Math.min(i * 60, 300)}ms`;
  });

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
    (entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add("clavr-in-view");
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    },
    { threshold: 0, rootMargin: "200px 0px -40px 0px" }
  );
  revealTargets.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));

  // Safety net: guarantee nothing stays permanently hidden (e.g. TOC jump-links
  // that skip past the scroll frames IntersectionObserver relies on).
  setTimeout(() => {
    revealTargets.forEach((el) => el.classList.add("clavr-in-view"));
  }, 2500);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("footprint-canvas");
  const page = canvas ? canvas.parentElement : null;
  if (!canvas || !page) return;

  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  let width, height;
  const footprints = [];
  const LIFE_MS = 1700;
  const MIN_STEP = 30;
  let lastX = null;
  let lastY = null;
  let side = 1;

  function resize() {
    width = canvas.width = page.offsetWidth;
    height = canvas.height = page.offsetHeight;
  }
  resize();
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(page);

  function handleMove(e) {
    const rect = page.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

    if (lastX === null) {
      lastX = x;
      lastY = y;
      return;
    }

    const dx = x - lastX;
    const dy = y - lastY;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

    if (dist >= MIN_STEP) {
      const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
      side *= -1;
      footprints.push({ x, y, angle, side, born: performance.now() });
      if (footprints.length > 80) footprints.shift();
      lastX = x;
      lastY = y;
    }
  }

  page.addEventListener("mousemove", handleMove);
  page.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
    lastX = null;
    lastY = null;
  });

  function drawFootprint(fp, now) {
    const age = now - fp.born;
    if (age > LIFE_MS) return false;

    const opacity = 0.65 * (1 - age / LIFE_MS);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(fp.x, fp.y);
    ctx.rotate(fp.angle + Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.translate(fp.side * 6, 0);
    ctx.scale(fp.side, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = opacity;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2c5d85";

    // forefoot pad
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, -5, 5.2, 5.8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // heel pad (gap between the two mimics a shoe-sole print)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 8.5, 3.4, 4.2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
    return true;
  }

  function step() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
    const now = performance.now();
    for (let i = footprints.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (!drawFootprint(footprints[i], now)) {
        footprints.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
})();
</script>
